scope: Read-only source plus static binary decoding/hash/array comparisons. No project imports/native execution, geometry/source queries, meshing, complete comparator or tests. This is a binding design, not an executed V3 comparison or new scientific acceptance.

independent_anchor.rule: Require this exact pre-existing STOP review digest before accepting expected file pins from surface_input_output_pins. Never derive expected pins from arbitrarily current files or overwrite original V1/V2 failed receipts.

binary_format.header: 8-byte exact magic followed by3 little-endian uint64 counts nv,nt,ne; total32bytes.
binary_format.vertex_record: Packed little-endian <ddd i BB dddddd,78bytes, no native struct alignment. Offsets xyz0..23/ref24..27/corner28/required29/metric30..77.
binary_format.triangle_record: <iiii,16bytes: three ONE-based vertex indices, then persistent sheet ref.
binary_format.edge_record: <iiiBB,14bytes: two ONE-based vertex indices, persistent curve ref, ridge byte, required byte.
binary_format.required_length: 32+78*nv+16*nt+14*ne, checked before allocations, reject truncation/trailing bytes and count overflow.
binary_format.INITIAL_binding: For explicit nodal/current retained case carrier disabled/NotRun: decoded vertex xyz must byte-equal INITIAL.coordinates; decoded face indices minus1 cast<i8 must byte-equal INITIAL.triangles. General adaptive carriers may change geometry, so this is not a universal INITIAL->metric equality rule.
binary_format.raw_mesh: Text Medit MeshVersionFormatted2,Dimension3; Vertices29866 and Triangles59732, references separate. This is MMGS output before canonicalization/source projection; do not equate raw.mesh point coordinates directly to final SURFACE.npz.

negative_test_plan: Change one metric tensor/coordinate/ref/flag byte while preserving length and rehashing a local sidecar: independent STOP pin must refuse.
Alter both metric xyz and INITIAL coordinate coherently: independent expected file pins must still refuse.
Change nv/nt/ne, magic, index range, partial vertex record, trailing byte or triangle incidence/reference: strict decoder or independent pin must refuse; no native call.
Substitute runner/library or wrong qualified dependency hash: own native implementation authentication must refuse.
Break metric/INITIAL/raw.mesh expected receipt digest or tamper STOP review/pin map: trusted independent anchor refusal.
Change policy/threshold/metric_response_factor or semantic native command operand alongside same scratch aggregate: strict semantics must refuse.
Only named aggregate value may differ while every scientific/file/receipt/method premise holds; negative noninteger/negative/bool/nan aggregate must refuse.
Preserve V1 and V2 failed receipts and immutable input file inventories; retain all prior own-parent/native/apex tamper controls.
